Apple (AAPL) Position Has Increased by Intersect Capital Llc; Albert D Mason Has Raised Holding in Omnicom Group (OMC) 
April 24, 2018 - By Hazel Jackson 
Albert D Mason Inc increased its stake in Omnicom Group (OMC) by 14.8% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Albert D Mason Inc bought 4,586 shares as the company’s stock declined 1.21% with the market. The institutional investor held 35,572 shares of the advertising company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.59M, up from 30,986 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Albert D Mason Inc who had been investing in Omnicom Group for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $16.66 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.80% or $0.59 during the last trading session, reaching $73.29. About 1.80 million shares traded. Omnicom Group Inc. (NYSE:OMC) has declined 13.63% since April 24, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 25.18% the S&P500. 
Intersect Capital Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 7.27% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Intersect Capital Llc bought 2,867 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 42,319 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $7.16M, up from 39,452 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Intersect Capital Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $826.76B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.39% or $2.3 during the last trading session, reaching $162.94. About 31.71 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 24, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
